info.title: Contacts API
info.description: CSE341 Contacts Project API Documentation for Week 02 CRUD Operations with Data Validation tracking.

get.description: Retrieves all contact documents currently stored in the MongoDB cluster.

200.description: Array of contact documents retrieved successfully

post.description: Inserts a brand new contact document into the database collection. All payload keys are strictly required and run through validation rules.

201.description: Document Created. Returns the unique string ID generated by MongoDB.

412.description: Precondition Failed. Data validation validation checks failed (e.g. malformed email syntax).

get.description: Retrieves a singular contact document filtering by its precise database Hex-string ObjectId.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Hexadecimal string identifier string of the document

404.description: No contact document matched the given identifier

put.description: Overwrites an existing contact document completely using a full schema replacement payload. Payload data runs through structural validation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Hexadecimal string identifier of the document to modify

204.description: Document Modified Successfully. No content returned.

412.description: Precondition Failed. Payload data failed rules checks.

500.description: Modification Failure or Hex ID non-existent

delete.description: Removes a specific contact document permanently from the collection cluster matching the criteria ID parameter.

204.description: Document Purged Successfully. No payload returned.

500.description: Target ID missing or purge operation dropped
